title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- feat(integrations)!: Name real vendor parameters on recently shipped providers ([#3289](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3289) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add GitHub search and gist actions ([#3285](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3285) )
- feat(integrations): Add Rippling HRIS integration ([#3286](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3286) )
- feat(integrations): Add Jamf Pro and Iru MDM integrations ([#3287](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3287) )
- feat(integrations): Add OSINT and threat intelligence provider templates ([#3288](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3288) )
- fix(integrations): Repair bracketed pagination inputs and numeric ID filters ([#3291](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3291) )
- feat(integrations): Support Shared Drives across the Drive integration ([#3295](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3295) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Otel config and deployment plumbing ([#2638](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/2638) )
- feat(agents): Otel wiring ([#2650](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/2650) )


## Enhancements


- feat(ui): Make version history shell host-configurable ([#3279](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3279) )


## Bug fixes


- fix(agents): Harden expression resolution at durable sinks ([#3234](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3234) )
- fix(ui): Centralize React Query error handling ([#3271](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3271) )
- fix(engine): Persist action environment on create and edit ([#3278](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3278) )
- fix(api): Leave org enrollment to provisioning and invitations ([#3297](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3297) )


## Other


- feat(cases): Add title and description versioning ([#3272](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3272) )
- feat(cases): Add case version history and restore APIs ([#3282](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3282) )
- fix(rbac): Expose integration permissions ([#3294](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3294) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11)
